title: Douyin Full-Funnel Agency Duola Ameng Raises Angel from CMC Capital
summary: On Dec 6, 2022, content+data-driven Douyin full-funnel marketer and Douyin ecom certified quality vendor Duola Ameng (多啦阿梦) raised an angel round from CMC Capital. Use of proceeds: core tech, team expansion, CX. First financing; founder holds 99% of two natural persons.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · December 14, 2022

On Dec 6, 2022, content+data-driven Douyin full-funnel marketer and Douyin ecom certified quality vendor Duola Ameng (多啦阿梦) raised an angel round from CMC Capital. Use of proceeds: core tech, team expansion, CX. First financing; founder holds 99% of two natural persons.

Founded Mar 2021 in Shanghai; started in beauty/CPG — deep work with 3CE, L’Oréal, Elizabeth Arden, EVELOM, Guerlain, Sisley, Fresh, Lancôme, La Roche-Posay, Clarins, SkinCeuticals, etc. Platform data cited: Douyin GMV +2.2× YoY; >10B items sold via Douyin ecom in past year. Services: brand self-live, short-video shoot, media buy, analytics, plus Douyin marketing/assortment strategy and attribution. Proprietary visual analytics + live-management systems; data factory across audience/content/creator/SKU; FACT-model ops, short-video conversion, mall ops awards; co-built marketing-science methods with Ocean Engine YunTu; won Ocean Engine Marketing Gold; passed “Ocean Engine Marketing Science Certified Vendor” after formal defense — official Douyin ecom cert + tech support for brand+performance+sales full-funnel.

CMC: PE covering tech/consumer/entertainment; bullish on Douyin content-ecom trillion-RMB GMV structural opportunity and Duola’s ops strength.

— END —
